issues.problem: nikagitte example 1 English 'The phone never stops ringing' overstates 電話がたくさんかかってくる.
issues.action: Changed to 'I get loads of calls just when I'm busy.'

issues.problem: nikagitte explain implied に限って can never be a neutral limitation; formal neutral use (会員に限って入場できます) exists.
issues.action: Acknowledged the formal neutral use while keeping the advice to use だけ / に限り for neutral limitation.

issues.problem: bakarika explain grouped ばかりでなく under the no-request restriction; ばかりでなく is acceptable before requests.
issues.action: Restricted the rule to ばかりか and noted ばかりでなく is also acceptable there.

issues.problem: dokoroka explain was missing the common understatement use (一時間どころか三時間も待った), where B goes the same direction as A.
issues.action: Added it as a third use, changed 'two uses' to 'three uses', and reworded the rule to 'wrong, or far too small'.

issues.problem: dokoroka tip 'If the second half agrees with the first, it is not' would misclassify the understatement use.
issues.action: Rewrote the tip around whether A turns out false.

issues.problem: wamochiron example 3 English was awkward ('as well as, of course, your name').
issues.action: Changed to 'Please write your name, of course, and your address too.'

issues.problem: Intro said 'formal speech, news and speeches' (redundant).
issues.action: Changed to 'formal writing, news and speeches'.
